schema: ATT&CK technique ID -> per-platform runnable containment one-liners
notes: All commands are advisory. Operators MUST review before execution. Commands prefer reversible actions (block, isolate, suspend) over destructive (delete, wipe).

isolate_host.description: Cut network egress to contain spread
isolate_host.windows_powershell: New-NetFirewallRule -DisplayName 'MH-Isolate-Egress' -Direction Outbound -Action Block -Enabled True; New-NetFirewallRule -DisplayName 'MH-Isolate-Ingress' -Direction Inbound -Action Block -Enabled True
isolate_host.linux_bash: sudo iptables -I OUTPUT 1 -j DROP && sudo iptables -I INPUT 1 -j DROP
isolate_host.macos_bash: sudo pfctl -e && echo 'block all' | sudo pfctl -f -
isolate_host.blast_radius_hint: isolates one host; SSH/RDP into that host will stop working

rotate_credentials.description: Force password reset for impacted user
rotate_credentials.blast_radius_hint: single user account; legitimate sessions will be disrupted

snapshot_evidence.description: Capture memory + disk snapshot before any host change
snapshot_evidence.linux_bash: sudo avml /evidence/<HOST>-mem.lime; sudo dd if=/dev/sda of=/evidence/<HOST>-disk.raw bs=4M status=progress
snapshot_evidence.blast_radius_hint: read-only operation on the source host

actions.description: Enable LSA Protection (RunAsPPL) to block userland LSASS reads
Rotate all local + cached domain credentials on affected host
actions.windows_powershell: klist purge; ksetup /clearKbtgt; Get-LocalUser | ForEach-Object { Set-LocalUser -Name $_.Name -PasswordNeverExpires:$false }

actions.description: Turn on PowerShell ScriptBlock logging for forward visibility

T1059.003.name: Command and Scripting Interpreter: Windows Command Shell

T1547.001.name: Boot or Logon Autostart Execution: Registry Run Keys

actions.description: Remove Run/RunOnce key for suspicious entry (preserves rest)

T1543.003.name: Create or Modify System Process: Windows Service

actions.description: Stop the service and set start type to disabled

T1543.002.name: Create or Modify System Process: Systemd Service

actions.description: Stop unit and mask to prevent re-activation
actions.linux_bash: sudo systemctl stop <UNIT>; sudo systemctl mask <UNIT>

T1543.001.name: Create or Modify System Process: Launch Agent

actions.description: Unload the suspect LaunchAgent and quarantine the plist
Disable the suspicious scheduled task without deleting (preserves audit trail)
Comment out the suspect crontab line (reversible) for the affected user
actions.linux_bash: sudo crontab -u <USER> -l | sed 's|^<CRON_PATTERN>|# MH-DISABLED &|' | sudo crontab -u <USER> -
actions.macos_bash: sudo crontab -u <USER> -l | sed 's|^<CRON_PATTERN>|# MH-DISABLED &|' | sudo crontab -u <USER> -

actions.description: Drop traffic to the C2 IP/host at the host firewall
actions.macos_bash: echo 'block out quick to <C2_IP>' | sudo pfctl -ef -

actions.description: Disable the compromised account (reversible vs. delete)
Move the obfuscated artifact to a quarantine path (preserves for analysis)
